title: Why the US lags in life expectancy

scenes.narration: Did you know the US started with the same life expectancy as other wealthy nations?

visual.text: Why the US lags in life expectancy

scenes.narration: In 1980, the United States was right there with Germany.
But while they soared, American progress slowed down.

title: Wealth doesn't always buy longer lives

scenes.narration: Does having a stronger economy guarantee you a longer life?

visual.text: Wealth doesn't always buy longer lives

scenes.narration: The US is the wealthiest, yet ranks lower in life expectancy.
Japan proves that even with less GDP, people live longer.
The full story is on the channel.
How much has life expectancy actually grown since 1980?
Australia saw a 13 percent increase in average lifespan.
The United States only managed an 8 percent gain.
The full story is on the channel.
